title: Tensor nonvanishing for bounded-above coherent complexes over a local ring
statement: Let $(R,\mathfrak m)$ be a commutative Noetherian local ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], where $\mathfrak m$ is its unique maximal ideal. Work in the ordinary module derived category $D(R)$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Write $D^-_{\mathrm{fg}}(R)$ for objects with cohomology bounded above and finitely generated [def-weil-finitely-generated-module] in every degree. For $U,V\in D^-_{\mathrm{fg}}(R)$ let $U\otimes_R^{\mathbf L}V$ be the derived tensor product, computed by taking bounded-above free resolutions and totalizing their tensor complex with direct sums and the differential $d(u\otimes v)=du\otimes v+(-1)^{\deg u}u\otimes dv$. Then $U\otimes_R^{\mathbf L}V\in D^-_{\mathrm{fg}}(R)$, and $U\otimes_R^{\mathbf L}V=0$ if and only if $U=0$ or $V=0$. No finite Tor-dimension hypothesis is imposed on either factor.
